_readme: The photography schedule. Every image the site needs, with the shot brief
attached to it.
A slot is served by one of three things, in this order:
file    a photograph. Drop it in assets/photos/ and set this; it wins
over everything below and the slot becomes a plain .
figure  a drawing, generated by tools/make-figures.py from the same data
the rest of the site is built from. It renders as an image and
says on its face that it is a drawing. A stand-in, not a
substitute: the brief below still stands.
neither the slot renders at the right aspect ratio with the brief printed
in it, so the layout holds and the shot list is the site itself.
ratio   width/height the layout reserves. Shoot to it or wider and crop.
min     shortest acceptable long edge in pixels, for retail listings.
brief   subject, angle, background, lighting. Written for a photographer.
alt     the alt text once the photograph exists.
figure_alt  the alt text while the drawing stands in for it.
NO PHOTOGRAPH HAS BEEN TAKEN. Every `file` is null. Nine slots carry a
drawing: the three retail bags, the three pack formats and the three grain
plates. The eight that need a camera on a real subject - the five market
shots, the two plant shots and the retail shelf - are still empty briefs,
because no drawing can honestly stand in for a photograph of a place.

product-fine-bag20.brief: 20 lb printed retail bag, fine grade, standing, three-quarter front, plain white sweep, soft top light, no props.
product-fine-bag20.alt: 20 lb printed retail bag of fine grade aragonite

product-medium-bag20.figure_alt: Drawing of the 20 lb printed retail bag, medium grade, with the grain window shown at actual size
product-medium-bag20.brief: 20 lb printed retail bag, medium grade, standing, three-quarter front, plain white sweep, matched to the fine-grade frame.
product-medium-bag20.alt: 20 lb printed retail bag of medium grade aragonite

product-coarse-bag20.figure_alt: Drawing of the 20 lb printed retail bag, coarse grade, with the grain window shown at actual size
product-coarse-bag20.brief: 20 lb printed retail bag, coarse grade, standing, three-quarter front, plain white sweep, matched to the fine-grade frame.
product-coarse-bag20.alt: 20 lb printed retail bag of coarse grade aragonite

pack-bag50.figure_alt: Drawing of the 50 lb woven polypropylene trade bag, grade marked at packing
pack-bag50.brief: 50 lb plain woven poly trade bag, standing, three-quarter front, plain white sweep. Print and lot code legible.

pack-tote.figure_alt: Drawing of a 2,000 lb FIBC bulk bag with four lift loops, standing on a 48 by 40 inch pallet
pack-tote.brief: 2,000 lb FIBC bulk bag, filled, on a pallet, four loops visible, plain background or clean warehouse floor.
pack-tote.alt: 2,000 lb bulk bag on a pallet

pack-bulk.figure_alt: Drawing of a bulk aragonite stockpile beside a walking-floor trailer carrying a 24 ton load
pack-bulk.brief: Bulk aragonite loading into a walking-floor trailer, or a stockpile with a loader for scale. Daylight.

grain-fine.figure_alt: Drawing of fine grade aragonite grains at true scale against a millimetre rule
grain-fine.brief: Macro of fine grade with a millimetre rule in frame, top-down, even diffuse light, focus stacked so the whole field is sharp.
grain-fine.alt: Macro photograph of fine grade aragonite against a millimetre rule

grain-medium.figure_alt: Drawing of medium grade aragonite grains at true scale against a millimetre rule
grain-medium.brief: Macro of medium grade with a millimetre rule in frame, same camera height and lighting as the fine-grade macro.
grain-medium.alt: Macro photograph of medium grade aragonite against a millimetre rule

grain-coarse.figure_alt: Drawing of coarse grade aragonite grains at true scale against a millimetre rule
grain-coarse.brief: Macro of coarse grade with a millimetre rule in frame, same camera height and lighting as the other two macros.
grain-coarse.alt: Macro photograph of coarse grade aragonite against a millimetre rule

market-aquarium.brief: Established marine tank with a visible substrate bed, shot level with the bed line. No livestock close-ups.
market-aquarium.alt: Aragonite substrate bed in a marine aquarium

market-agriculture.brief: Aragonite spread on worked soil, or a spreader in a field. Daylight, no people identifiable.
market-agriculture.alt: Aragonite applied as a soil amendment

market-feed.brief: Mineral blending or a feed-mill hopper, clean and current. Avoid livestock imagery.
market-feed.alt: Aragonite handled as a feed mineral

market-turf.brief: Top-dressing a sand rootzone, or a prepared sports-field surface. Daylight.
market-turf.alt: Aragonite top-dressing on a sand rootzone

market-water.brief: Contact media vessel or a filter bed with the media visible. Clean plant, no branding of other suppliers.
market-water.alt: Aragonite contact media in a water treatment vessel

facility-screening.brief: Screening deck running, wide, from the operator walkway. Plant lit, no faces. This is the page-width banner.
facility-screening.alt: Screening deck at the Stockton plant

facility-packing.brief: Bagging line with a filled bag on the scale, or palletised finished goods stretch-wrapped and labelled.
facility-packing.alt: Bagging line at the Stockton plant

shelf-set.brief: Three grades faced side by side on a retail shelf, straight on, shelf label visible. Shot in a real store if possible.
shelf-set.alt: Three grades of aragonite faced on a retail shelf
